text:
kevin park: Hey team — hotel at BOS put a $300 incidental hold on my personal card because our Redwood corpcard was declined at check-in. I paid room rate on corpcard later but bank still has the hold. Can finance reimburse the $300 hold as an incidental? I attached the folio and the auth screenshot.
joanne (travel-ops): Sorry that happened. Did the hotel provide a merchant folio showing the auth code? Often holds drop in 3-7 days. If you need cash short-term, we can do a temporary advance.
kevin park: Uploaded auth_screenshot.jpg and folio_boston.pdf to Expensify. Auth code AHX-9090 shows "AUTH 300.00" but final folio shows room charge paid by corpcard. The hold hasn't released and it's blocking my debit account.
omar (manager): Confirming this was client travel and hotel for presales workshops on 4/12-4/13. Approve reimbursement for the incidental hold pending refund. If hotel refunds the hold to Kevin, finance will claw back. Approving now.
payments-bot: Notice: Incidental holds are usually temporary. Finance policy: refundable authorizations are reimbursable only when there's a demonstrated cash hardship AND manager approval. Opened ticket FIN-9033.
rachel (finance): Hi Kevin. We can do an interim payout of $300 as an "incidental advance" marked for reconciliation after 14 days. Two requirements: 1) manager approval in thread (we have it), 2) upload proof of final folio showing the hold cleared or a refund trace if it resolves. If the hotel refunds the hold back to your card, you must submit proof and we'll offset future expenses or request repayment. Do you want the interim payout?
kevin park: Yes please — I need it. Debit account is at zero until the hold drops.
rachel (finance): Ok triggered INC-ADV under FIN-9033-A. Payout method: ACH to your on-file bank. Expect settlement 2 business days. Note: This will be flagged for manual reconciliation; please monitor your card and upload any refund evidence within 14 days.
payments-bot: FIN-9033-A created: interim payout queued. Reminder: if refund evidence not provided within 14 days, amount will be treated as final reimbursable expense.
kevin park: thanks. One Q: what if the hotel posts the refund to corpcard instead of my personal card?
rachel (finance): If refund goes to the corpcard, great — we'll mark the interim payout as recovered and close the ticket. If refund hits your personal card, upload the bank refund screenshot and merchant confirmation and we'll offset. Either way, keep receipts and the folio.
joanne (travel-ops): I filed a feedback ticket with hotels ops to remind partner properties to accept corpcard for full incidentals. Also suggesting we add a pre-check for holds in travel guidance.
omar (manager): Thanks all. Kevin, please DM me if anything else pops up while traveling.
kevin park: Uploaded refund_trail.jpg (will update if auth clears). Really appreciate the fast help. :pray:
